definitions.gloss: stone construction; built of stone; stonework
definitions.explanation: A building, structure, or object made primarily of stone. Also used as a modifier to describe something built from stone.

examples.japanese: {石造|いしづく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧。
⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{石造|いしづく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many stone buildings in Europe.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百年以上前|ひゃくねんいじょうまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧{石造|いしづく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建築物|けんちくぶつ}→建築物：21292_kenchikubutsu⟧だ。
examples.english: This church is a stone structure built over a hundred years ago.

notes:
USAGE:
{石造|いしづく}り is typically used as a modifier before nouns using the ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ particle: {石造|いしづく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧. It can also stand alone as a noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {石造|いしづく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧ (stone house)
- {石造|いしづく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧ (stone wall)
- {石造|いしづく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{蔵|くら}→蔵：13991_kura⟧ (stone storehouse)

RELATED PATTERNS:
The ～{造|づく}り pattern is productive: {木造|もくぞう}り (wooden construction), ⟦{鉄筋|てっきん}コンクリート→鉄筋コンクリート：17904_tekkinkonkuriito⟧{造|づく}り (reinforced concrete construction).
